title: orthosia selloana
intro: Orthosia selloana, commonly known as Sello's Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Onagraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions such as acne and eczema. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
